title: Full CAC Lifecycle
description: End-to-end Crimes Against Children modeling guidance: hotline or CyberTip intake, grooming or trafficking conduct, forensic provenance of media, rescue, task-force coordination, and legal outcomes. Selects existing CAC modules and Facet sets; it does not classify files.
mission: Give investigators one starting point that names the existing CAC modules, Facet sets, and spine kinds typically needed for a full CAC case.

RasterPicture.notes: Media artifacts are RasterPicture (or File) observables. Do not use a CAC class as a stand-in for the bytes, and do not treat this profile as a classifier.

recipe_skeleton.summary: CACInvestigation + spine-typed roles/events/phases + hashed media + legal outcomes.
steps: Create CACInvestigation (not a bare Investigation) when the case is CAC.
Anchor people as PersonLikeEntity + Role. Never type the person as the role.
Model conduct as ExploitationEvent / GroomingBehavior with Phase progression.
Model intake as hotline/NCMECCybertipReport using the classes declared by that module.
Model media as RasterPicture with the HashIntelligence Facet set; record acquisition and verification actions separately.
Model rescue, task force, and charges with the matching existing CAC modules.
